composition: Reformed church and parsonage at the east end of Grindelwald · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Reformed church of Grindelwald closes the east end of the village, a hall of 1793–95 with a polygonal choir, tuff-framed round-arched windows, and a tower replaced in 1875. The parsonage of 1784–89 stands beside it. This is the church exterior, not the First cliff walk and not the Eiger north-face portrait. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and cool, about 12°C, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
